name: MK Electron Co., Ltd.
summary: MK Electron Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and markets semiconductor materials in Korea, Taiwan, China, and Southeast Asia. It offers bonding wires and solders balls, including gold bonding wires, copper bonding wires, AG based wires, and advanced Au-Ag-alloy bonding wires, as well as sputtering target products made of gold based alloy, and evaporation materials. The company provides CCSB, solder paste, and solder bar. MK Electron Co., Ltd. was founded in 1982 and is based in Yongin-si, South Korea.
